## Summary

Claims operations manager with twelve years in property and casualty insurance, from field
adjusting to running a 40-person auto and property claims unit. Known for turning backlog and
leakage numbers into process changes that stick, and for keeping adjusters, vendors and the
legal team on the same page.

## Experience

### Harrowgate Mutual Insurance — Claims Operations Manager
May 2019 – Present · Hamilton, ON (regional P&C mutual, 220,000 policies)

- Managed a 40-person auto and property claims unit across three teams, holding average cycle time at 11 days against a provincial peer median of 16.
- Cut the open-claim backlog from 2,900 to 1,100 files in nine months by introducing daily triage stand-ups and a severity-based assignment rule.
- Led the migration of first-notice-of-loss intake from a paper-and-email process to Guidewire ClaimCenter, retiring four spreadsheets and one legacy mainframe screen.
- Reduced claims leakage by 1.8 points of loss ratio through a reserve-review checklist and a second-signature rule on settlements above 25,000 dollars.
- Built the unit's monthly operations dashboard in Power BI, giving team leads same-day visibility of aging, reopen rate and vendor spend.
- Renegotiated the preferred auto-body and restoration vendor panel, cutting average repair cost per claim by 6% while keeping customer satisfaction above 4.5 out of 5.
- Rolled out a fraud-indicator screening step at intake that raised special-investigations referrals by 30% with no increase in false referrals.
- Ran the unit's response to a regional hailstorm event, standing up a catastrophe desk that closed 1,400 property claims in six weeks.
- Coached three team leads through their first year in role, with all three retained and one promoted to a regional post.

### Pellworth General Insurance — Senior Claims Adjuster
February 2014 – April 2019 · Burlington, ON

- Handled a caseload of 180 complex auto and property claims a year, including total losses, large water losses and accident-benefits files.
- Settled bodily-injury claims within the Statutory Accident Benefits Schedule limits with an average settlement 12% under initial reserve.
- Identified and documented 22 fraudulent or inflated claims over five years, saving an estimated 1.3 million dollars in indemnity payments.
- Wrote the branch's subrogation playbook, raising recoveries from third-party insurers by 40% in its first year.
- Prepared litigation files and attended examinations for discovery on 15 contested claims, working with defence counsel to settle 12 before trial.
- Trained eight junior adjusters on coverage analysis under the Ontario Automobile Policy and on estimate review in Xactimate.
- Piloted a desk-adjusting workflow for small property claims that let adjusters close claims under 5,000 dollars without a field visit.
- Led the branch's quarterly file-quality audits, reducing audit exceptions from 14% to 5% of files reviewed.
- Served as the branch's point of contact for the provincial regulator on complaint files, closing all 31 complaints inside the required window.
